newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 21.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on Friday.
WASHINGTON - The World Bank has unveiled a proposed restructuring of the lending institution.
WASHINGTON - Major league sports teams are in the midst of an unprecedented construction boom, and that means a lot of old venues are being abandoned.

WASHINGTON - Prudential Insurance Co of America's agreement with three of four states that had objected to a class action settlement of charges that the company routinely misled the elderly about life insurance costs.
NEW YORK - Stock prices sank for a second day, and some analysts said they expected the pullback to continue.
